game.title: Baldur's Gate 3
game.blurb: Party-based fantasy RPG from Larian Studios, released 2023-08-03. RAWG average playtime: 20 hours (well under a full run). Genres: Adventure, RPG, Strategy. Chapters follow the three-act outline on StrategyWiki's contents page.

chapters.title: Act One
chapters.summary: Escape the ship and explore the wilds: the grove, the goblins, the Underdark and the mountain pass.

chapters.title: Act Two
chapters.summary: Journey into the shadow-cursed lands and find a way to Moonrise Towers.

chapters.title: Act Three
chapters.summary: Reach the city of Baldur's Gate and gather allies for the final fight.

chapters.title: Story Milestones
chapters.summary: Big story moments and endings. Steam hides these, so they stay spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Companions and Camp
chapters.summary: Your party, their personal quests and life at camp.

chapters.title: Combat Tricks
chapters.summary: Creative ways to win fights: shoves, throws, unarmed hits and multi-attacks.

chapters.title: Exploration and Skills
chapters.summary: Background goals, books, chests, alchemy, music, hirelings and multiclassing.

chapters.title: Tactician and Honour Modes
chapters.summary: Finishing the game on the hardest settings.

notes: StrategyWiki has the guide under "Baldur's Gate III" (completion stage 0). Only its Table of Contents exists; it lists the three acts, main quests, regions and companion quests, but none of those subpages are written yet. Chapter structure follows that outline (page names only). baldursgate.fandom.com answers the API, but its page only links to about 16 general pages. bg3.wiki is not on the allowed-wiki list for this job, so it was not checked. 29 of 54 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in Story Milestones.
